Hire the machine the job demands

From powered access to groundworks plant, storage and site welfare — one enquiry covers the equipment your project needs.

Plant · 01

Telehandlers

The site workhorse for lifting and placing loads — pallets, blocks and materials moved safely to exactly where they are needed, at ground level or at height.

Access · 02

Scissor Lifts

A stable, spacious platform that rises straight up — ideal for fit-out, installation, maintenance and warehouse work where you need room to work at height.

Boom Lifts

Articulated and telescopic booms that reach up, out and over obstacles — for cladding, roofing, steelwork, signage and any job a straight lift cannot reach.

Why Choose R&M

Hire, handled properly

Every project runs to a programme, and the wrong machine — or a machine that arrives late — costs time and money. R&M Plant Hire keeps things straightforward: a wide range of well-kept equipment, hire periods that flex around your programme, and a team that treats your deadline like its own.

Send one enquiry and we will help you match the equipment to the job, confirm availability, and arrange the hire from start to finish.

Start an Enquiry

Wide range of equipment

Plant, powered access, site storage and welfare under one roof — so one enquiry can kit out the whole site.

Flexible hire options

Short jobs and long programmes alike — hire periods arranged around the way your project actually runs.

Reliable equipment

Machines supplied ready to work, so your crew can get straight on with the job when the kit arrives.

Customer-focused service

Real advice on choosing the right machine — tell us about the job and we will point you at the kit that fits it.

Professional approach

Clear communication from enquiry to off-hire — you always know what is coming, when, and what happens next.

How It Works

From enquiry to on-site in four steps

Hiring plant should be the easiest part of the job. Here is how it works with R&M.

01

Choose Your Equipment

Browse the categories above and pick the machine or site kit your project needs — or ask us for a recommendation.

02

Send Your Enquiry

Complete the enquiry form with your dates, duration and site location so we have everything in one place.

03

Confirm Availability

We check the equipment against your dates and confirm availability, along with anything else the job requires.

04

Arrange Your Hire

With everything agreed, we arrange your hire so the equipment is ready to work when your project needs it.
